issues.legal_issue: The period during which a court order restrains an action or proceeding taken in pursuance of a land-acquisition declaration is excluded when computing the time allowed for making the award, even if the order restrains only taking possession.
material_facts: A landholder challenged a land-acquisition declaration and obtained an interim court order restraining the authorities from taking possession of the land.
The acquisition officer continued the compensation inquiry, but no award was made within the unadjusted two-year period after publication of the declaration.
The landholder argued that the acquisition proceedings had lapsed because the order restraining possession did not stay steps leading to the award.
issues.conclusion: The period during which the court order restrained taking possession was excluded from the time for making the award, so the acquisition proceedings did not lapse on the ground asserted; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 11-A and its Explanation of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the period during which any action or proceeding to be taken in pursuance of a Section 6 declaration is stayed by a court order is excluded when computing the award period. The Explanation is in wide terms and is not confined to proceedings before the award; Section 17 permits possession before an award in urgent cases, supporting a consistent reading. The Court approved the Gujarat High Court's interpretation and disapproved S. Bavajan Sahib v. State of Kerala, AIR 1988 Kerala 280.

predicates.land_acquisition_award_deadline_case: The proceeding concerns whether acquisition proceedings lapse because an award was not made within the applicable time after a land-acquisition declaration.
predicates.landholder_obtained_court_order: The landholder obtained an order from a court during the acquisition proceedings.
predicates.court_order_stayed_action_pursuant_to_de: The court order stayed an action or proceeding to be taken in pursuance of the acquisition declaration.

issues.definition: When an award-deadline proceeding involves a court order obtained by the landholder that stays action pursuant to the declaration, the period covered by that stay is excluded from the award deadline.
